column3: Close to the Hebrew; “sitting [on the] cherubim” is rendered “enthroned above the cherubim.”
Close to the Hebrew; “give thanks to” is rendered “praise,” and “to be feared” as “awesome.”
Close to the Hebrew; “uprightness” is rendered “equity,” and “you have done” as “You have executed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “bow down to” is rendered “worship at.”
Close to the Hebrew; NASB makes “a decree he gave to them” an object of “kept” (“And the statute that He gave them”).
“Avenging yourself on their deeds” is rendered “yet an avenger of their evil deeds,” adding “evil.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the mountain of his holiness” is rendered “His holy hill.”
